# Token Killers — LLM Cost Optimization

**A measurable service that cuts AI API spend by re-architecting prompts, context, and routing.**

Token Killers is an audit-and-rebuild service for teams bleeding money on AI APIs. It combines prompt/context compression, model routing, caching, and local-model offload — then proves the savings with a before/after calculator. The differentiator is that I run the same stack on my own hardware, so the claims are verifiable, not theoretical.

## Highlights
- Interactive savings calculator (public lead magnet)
- Local-LLM offload for privacy + zero marginal cost
- Playbook productized as a paid PDF

## Stack
LLM APIs, Local LLMs (Ollama/LM Studio), Prompt engineering
